analysis.summary: Lead Reclaim and Rubber Products Limited reported its H2 and FY26 financial results, highlighting a revenue growth of nearly 28% year-on-year to 39.82 crore and a significant expansion in EBITDA and PAT. Management discussed strategic initiatives including the installation of a 1.2 MW solar power plant, automation to reduce labor and electricity costs, and preferential fundraising of 35.58 crore to expand installed production capacity. The company is actively expanding into higher-margin verticals such as Tyre Pyrolysis Oil (TPO), Recovered Carbon Black (RCB), EPDM rubber, and crumb rubber, with operations slated to scale up through FY27 and FY28. Lead Reclaim and Rubber Products Limited reported its operational and financial results for H2 and FY26, highlighting a revenue of ₹3982 Lakhs and a PAT of ₹409 Lakhs. Management detailed the completion of the EPDM facility, the expansion of production capacity following a preferential issue, and solar plant commissioning plans.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching 20% to 25% exports in the current financial year.
guidance.quote: We are targeting to reach 20 to 25% exports in the current financial years.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports declined in the second quarter due to geographical effects.
demand_outlook.quote: Our exports have gone down, so the second quarter was not performed as compared to the first quarter

demand_outlook.claim: Raw material prices increased slightly in the last quarter due to geographical factors, but on a year-on-year basis the increase was around 1-2% and currently it is stable.
demand_outlook.quote: As I mentioned regarding raw materials, prices increased slightly in the last quarter due to geographical factors, but on a year-on-year basis the increase was around 1–2%, and currently it is stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the recycling and sustainable materials space is witnessing a structural shift supported by various factors.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycling and sustainable materials space is witnessing a structural shift, supported by rising environmental awareness, stricter regulatory frameworks, and the growing preference for cost-efficient alternatives to virgin inputs.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that it is seeing encouraging demand across all its key verticals.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing encouraging demand across all our key verticals.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the facility at Someshwar Industrial Estate is positioned to meet growing market demand in reclaimed rubber.
demand_outlook.quote: Positioned to meet growing market demand in reclaimed rubber.

capex_expansion.claim: The preferential fundraising of 35.58 crore will be utilized to significantly enhance the manufacturing footprint and expand installation capacity production from 960 metric tons per month to 2400 metric tons per month across all verticals post expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: This capital will be utilized to significantly enhance our manufacturing footprint and expand our installation capacity production for 960 metric tons per month to 2400 metric ton per month across all vertical post expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of installing a 1.2 MW solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of installing a 1.2 MW solar power plant, which is expected to further reduce our power costs significantly.

capex_expansion.claim: The TPO and RCB plants are expected to be operational by December of the year, subject to government compliances.
capex_expansion.quote: and it will be operationally the December this year but it's dependent on the government compliances also.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capacity increased substantially from 960 MT per month to 4,200 MT per month after the fund raise.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity has increased substantially from 960 MT per month to 4,200 MT per month after the fund raise, and we are steadily building the infrastructure needed to serve growing demand in a more efficient manner.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired approximately 9,300 sq. meters of land for a new facility at Someshwar Industrial Estate with construction expected to be completed by December 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Acquired approximately 9,300 sq. meters of land for a new facility. Construction is currently underway, with expected completion by December 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: Machinery investment includes a 20% advance payment already made with delivery expected in January 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Machinery Investment: 20% advance payment already made; delivery expected January 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning the installation of a 1.25 MW solar power plant for captive consumption.
capex_expansion.quote: Planning installation of a 1.25 MW solar power plant for captive consumption.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew strongly by over 130% to 8.52 crores, while profit after tax increased by more than 180% to 4.09 crore.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grow strongly by over 130% to 8.52 crores, while profit after tax increase by more than 180%- 4.09 crore, which result in EPS expansion 150% year on year.

margins_costs.claim: Automation helped reduce labor by 1-2% and electricity efficiency helped operations by 1%.
margins_costs.quote: automation has helped us reduce labour by 1-2% and electricity efficiency has helped our operations by 1%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects operating leverage, improved product mix, and better efficiencies to support performance over the medium term.
margins_costs.quote: As we scale, we expect operating leverage, improved product mix, and better efficiencies to support our performance over the medium term.

margins_costs.claim: The company initiated tyre imports to lower raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: Tyre Imports: Initiated imports to lower raw material costs.

margins_costs.claim: Automation machinery was added to enhance quality, increase efficiency, and slightly reduce manpower costs.
margins_costs.quote: Automation Machinery: Added machinery to enhance quality, increase efficiency, and slightly reduce manpower costs.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization after installing new machinery is at 54%.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently we are after the installation new machinery, we are on the 54% capacity utilization, so we have the more gap to increase our production capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Total approved government capacity for TPO and RCB combined is 60 metric tons per day.
orders_capacity.quote: The total approved government capacity is 60 metric tons per day.

orders_capacity.claim: Key business strategy includes expanding capacity from 460 MT to 960 MT per month with scalable technology.
orders_capacity.quote: Expanding capacity from 460 MT to 960 MT per month with scalable technology

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital has reduced from 96 days to 60 days, yielding higher returns in ROCE and ROE at 28% and 60% respectively.
capital_allocation.quote: Importantly, our working capital has reduced from 96 days to 60 days, which help us turn over cash flow from operational positive about 5.34 crore, and that yield higher returns in ROCE and ROE at 28% and 60% respectively.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully completed a preferential fundraising of 35.58 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: One of the key major milestones during the year was successfully preferential fundraising of 35.58 crore with participation of marquee investors and promoter groups, it's reflecting confidence in our long-term vision.

management_commitments.claim: The TPO plant is planned to be operational by December of the year, subject to government compliances.
management_commitments.quote: and it will be operationally the December this year but it's dependent on the government compliances also.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to reach 20% to 25% exports in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting to reach 20 to 25% exports in the current financial years.

management_commitments.claim: Construction of the new facility at Someshwar Industrial Estate is expected to be completed by December 2025.
management_commitments.quote: Construction is currently underway, with expected completion by December 2025.

management_commitments.claim: Delivery of machinery for which a 20% advance payment has been made is expected in January 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Machinery Investment: 20% advance payment already made; delivery expected January 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
